title: CelesTrak satellites
description: Orbital elements from CelesTrak (no API key; usage policy: elements update every two hours, each file is downloaded once per update). Objects selected by catalog number, designator or name are pinned: always emitted. Groups, special lists and supplemental files are emitted only over the map clients' viewports.

groups.title: Groups
groups.description: CelesTrak group names, e.g. active, stations, starlink, gps-ops, weather, geo

catalogNumbers.title: Catalog numbers
catalogNumbers.description: NORAD catalog numbers to pin, one request each (e.g. 25544 for the ISS)

designators.title: International designators
designators.description: Launch designators to pin, e.g. 1998-067 (every piece) or 1998-067A

names.title: Name searches
names.description: Partial satellite names to pin, e.g. ISS (ZARYA) or COSMOS 2251 DEB

special.title: Special lists
special.description: GPZ and GPZ-PLUS (geosynchronous), DECAYING (objects about to re-enter)

supplemental.title: Supplemental GP files
supplemental.description: Operator-supplied elements, usually better than the catalog for these constellations

refreshHours.title: Refresh (h)
refreshHours.description: How often elements are fetched; CelesTrak updates every two hours and blocks faster polling

backgroundIntervalSec.title: Background interval (s)
backgroundIntervalSec.description: How often every satellite is emitted wherever it is, so all are in the database for search; ones outside the viewed area update their entity but not track history. 0 disables.
